english_text: Rama was crowned king of Ayodhya, establishing Ramarajya—a golden age of truth, prosperity, and peace. Lava and Kusha, the twin sons of Rama and Sita, grew up in Valmiki's hermitage and sang the sacred story of the Ramayana before Rama, completing the epic cycle.
short_summary_english: Rama establishes a righteous reign in Ayodhya, and his sons Lava and Kusha sing the epic before him.
moral_lesson_english: Peace and prosperity are built upon selfless service and adherence to truth.
